loss: .5 CE + .25 per-tile weighted Dice + .25 per-image present-class weighted Lovasz-Softmax
auxiliary_warmup: 0 through epoch 10; linear ramp to full at 20
architecture: R031 fresh ImageNet V2 ResNet101 U-Net/scSE semantic root + R052-inspired raw-detail branch with semantic gate and zero-init high-resolution residual correction
sampling: 50% targeted >=10% Al3Ni/Eutectic equally; 50% any center tile
evaluator: 448 input, central224, stride112, reflect padding; image mean mIoU absent=one
direct_parent: R031 operating root; no R031 task checkpoint used
donor_mechanism: R052 raw grayscale half-resolution multi-scale depthwise detail path; no R052 task checkpoint used

shape_detail_branch.fusion: zero-initialized 1x1 residual into final 32-channel decoder feature

dice_reduction: spatial(2,3) per tile, weighted class mean then batch mean; smoothing1e-5 and absent-class inclusion unchanged
initialization: fresh official torchvision ImageNet V2 ResNet101; no KoMaP checkpoint
normalization: repeat grayscale into RGB and use ImageNet per-channel mean/std
photometric: mild brightness/contrast, gamma, Gaussian noise on train only
checkpoint_selection: best single-view halo validation each epoch; D4 only after selection
